title.narrative: Overall objective of the Action is to preserve the Ukrainian media market, preserve quality and ethical media organizations that oppose Russian manipulation and propaganda in the information war, and provide Ukrainian society and the world with verified and reliable information about events in Ukraine, in particular about the war.tration

description.narrative: During the first 3 months of the project, we have started providing support to at least 20 independent Ukrainian media organizations and thus preserving the Ukrainian media market from complete demolishing and ensuring its functioning at critical times. Because of the war, national and regional media found themselves under unprecedented pressure and needed financial and operational assistance. At the same time, regular people and regional communities needed information about the military situation in their regions to stay abreast of current events and make informed decisions. Thus the support provided to the media helped communities to live through the war. Thanks to the support the number of reports from the ground made by media professionals increased. It became possible through better provision of the necessary equipment and logistical support. At least 20 media received approvals upon their requests for core funding and technical support and started to receive financial assistance in September. Relocation and consultations from leading experts in strategy, operationalization, content, and financial planning helped media outlets reduce the time needed for adaptation to war conditions and work in new places. Preservation of media capacity through the provision of comprehensive support, including counseling and emergency funding, so that qualified personnel does not leave the media market due to lack of resources also took place. Technical assistance helped to strengthen the material base of newsrooms through the establishment of aid transmission channels, both by the MDF and by other benefactors. This includes legal assistance and the organization of this process exclusively in the legal field. Thanks to the MDF Coordination Center the Ukrainian media community consolidated and had the opportunity to continue operating and establish mutual assistance work with other media outlets and organizations to cover the war in Ukraine and show the real state of events to the world.
